topic.title: Vale Linter for Markdown and HTML Validation Add-on
topic.shortdesc: The Vale Linter for Markdown and HTML Validation add-on uses Vale to validate the current Markdown or HTML file and reports errors and warnings.

body.note:
This add-on is compatible with the following products:
Oxygen XML Editor
Oxygen XML Author
Oxygen XML Developer
Oxygen JSON Editor
body.p: The Vale Validation add-on runs the Vale linter over the currently edited file and presents the validation errors in the results area at the bottom of the application. A Linter is a tool that automatically verifies specific rules against your code or documentation. This is useful for enforcing a style guide or for catching commonly mistaken branding issues.
